tests.css/css-text/text-transform/text-transfo: The reference expects the simple uppercase mapping of the Greek Extended letters (U+1F80 gives U+1F88), but css-text-3 section 2.1.1 requires the full case mappings (U+1F80 gives U+1F08 U+0399), which the German sharp s tests need too.
tests.html/canvas/element/path-objects/2d.path: The canvas transform is single precision, so a scale of Number.MAX_VALUE overflows and isPointInPath finds nothing (see .claude/accepted-gaps/canvas-transform-is-single-precision.md).
